text:
sam_pd: quick sync - need to decide default "graceful degradation" mode for dedicated pools during regional pressure/outage. Two options: cross-region spillover vs local throttled-degrade + customer notification.
rita_ops: tl;dr: cross-region spillover keeps latency but costs more and has data transfer implications; local degrade preserves cost but increases tail latency and error rates for some tenants.
cheng_eng: implementation notes:
- spillover requires fast model routing + warm replicas in secondary region OR stateless fallbacks to smaller quantized variants.
- local degrade requires prioritized queueing + soft-eviction and clear tenant priority matrix.
tom_sales: customers care about predictability. Enterprise customers lean to spillover if we can guarantee <100ms added latency. SMBs prefer cheaper degrade.
sam_pd: proposal: hybrid default = local throttled-degrade + paid cross-region spillover add-on. Offer an escape hatch "auto-spillover" for suites with critical SLAs.
rita_ops: runbook items: notify customers via status + billing notice when auto-spillover triggers; create incident annotation in console.
cheng_eng: sample config snippet:
```
degrade_policy:
  mode: "local_throttle"  # default
  soft_evict_pct: 20
  spillover:
    enabled: false
    failover_regions: ["eu-west-1"]
    latency_budget_ms: 100
```
infra-bot: note: changing default affects telemetry: track spillover_count, degrade_evicts, cross_region_bytes.
sam_pd: launch criteria for default flip (i.e., ship hybrid packaging):
- eng: runtime flags + canary in two regions
- ops: runbook + automated billing annotation
- sales: add-on pricing + contract language
- metrics: spike in tail latency <8%, spillover false-positive <1% during canary
rita_ops: canary plan: 5 customers, 7d, simulate region saturation with synthetics and measure customer-visible latency.
tom_sales: pricing suggestion: monthly reserve + per-GB egress + small per-hour premium when spillover active.
cheng_eng: timeline ask: can we deliver runtime + metrics in 3 sprints for canary? yes but need prioritization.
sam_pd: decision: move forward with hybrid default (local degrade) + add-on spillover path. cheng will own runtime, rita owns canary/runbook, tom owns pricing/contract. We'll reconvene after canary results. :thumbsup:
